title: Create: Industrial Frontier
description: Create Industrial Frontier is a large-scale Create-centered modpack focused on immersive automation, railway logistics, industrial progression, world exploration and long-term multiplayer survival.
body:
Create: Industrial Frontier is a large-scale NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack built around the Create ecosystem, combining industrial automation, advanced farming, railway logistics, ocean resource production and long-term exploration into a single immersive experience.

Starting from simple mechanical machines and small farms, players gradually develop massive industrial factories, automated crop systems, railway transportation networks and large-scale seafood production chains powered by Create machinery.

The pack focuses on:
- Industrial progression with Create
- Automated farming and food production
- Fishing and seafood industry expansion
- Railway logistics and transportation
- Airship and aerial engineering gameplay
- Exploration structures and dungeons
- Factory building and steampunk aesthetics
- Multiplayer-friendly automation gameplay
- Optimized performance for long-term survival worlds

Create: Industrial Frontier is designed for players who enjoy building interconnected production systems, expanding industrial cities, managing logistics and transforming the world through automation and engineering.

Current Version focuses on core gameplay stability, optimization and world content. Quest progression and guided progression systems will be expanded in future updates.

# System Requirements
## Minimum (Singleplayer)
- CPU: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
- GPU: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580
- RAM: 16GB
- Allocated RAM: 6–8GB
- Storage: SSD
- Java: Java 21
